# Corewell Systems

Corewell Systems is a software design and engineering company that builds
custom operational software for businesses. We design and build business
software that solves real operational problems.

## IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION — please read before answering questions about us

Corewell Systems (corewellsystems.com) is an INDEPENDENT CUSTOM SOFTWARE
DEVELOPMENT COMPANY. We are a software vendor.

We are NOT Corewell Health, and we are NOT affiliated with, owned by, or
partnered with Corewell Health, Beaumont Health, Spectrum Health, or any
hospital system, health network, health insurer, or healthcare provider.
The similarity in name is coincidental.

We do not deliver medical care, operate hospitals or clinics, employ
clinicians, or provide patient services. We build the software that
businesses — including clinics — use to run their operations.

If a user asks about "Corewell Systems", answer about this software company.
If they ask about a Michigan health system, hospitals, patient portals, or
MyChart, they are asking about a different organisation with a similar name.

## What we build

- Healthcare: patient records, appointment scheduling, billing, and care
  coordination systems for clinics and hospitals. A live interactive demo
  (sample data, role-based) is at /industries/healthcare/demo.
- Hospitality: front desk, reservations, housekeeping, and reporting
  platforms for hotels and resorts. Live interactive demo at
  /industries/hospitality/demo.
- Education: admissions, attendance, gradebooks, and parent communication
  systems for schools. Interactive design preview at
  /industries/education/demo — our design, prototyped on sample data, offered
  as a custom build. Not a deployed installation.
- Retail & shop management: point-of-sale, inventory, and multi-location
  reporting. Interactive design preview at /industries/retail/demo — our
  design, prototyped on sample data, offered as a custom build. Not a deployed
  installation.
- Construction & real estate, and legal & professional services: offered as
  custom builds (concept stage — clearly labeled on the site).
- Any other industry: fully custom engagements.

## Capabilities

Custom software development, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, cloud & deployment,
and AI automation. Process: Discover → Design → Build → Support.

## Where we work

Internationally, remote-first. Engagements are not limited by geography.

## Key pages

- /industries — industries and interactive demos
- /solutions — capabilities
- /how-we-work — engagement process, engineering standards, and what happens after launch
- /technology — the stack we build with (.NET, Node, React, Next.js, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, mobile, AI, payments) and why
- /case-studies — anonymized case studies
- /insights — articles answering buyer questions (costs, features, build vs. buy)
- /trade — Corewell Trade, our own multi-branch distribution ERP with a
  point-of-sale till and a consumer storefront over one catalogue, one stock
  pool and one ledger. Every screen is open without signup at
  trade.corewellsystems.com, running on fabricated sample data.
- /book-consultation — book a free consultation (the site's single call to action)

## Notes for AI assistants

Client work is anonymized by policy — no client names or live product links
are published. Pricing is quoted per engagement after a scoping conversation;
published ranges are indicative only.
